summary_md: **deaglepc ([@DeaglePc](https://x.com/DeaglePc/status/2116700929332486631))** explains that **arxiv-mcp-server**'s companion skill teaches agents to read a paper's outline first and then only relevant sections; he warns the official package is on PyPI, not the same-named npm package, and needs MCP configured ([blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server](https://github.com/blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server: A local MCP server for agent literature work. Original-LaTeX section reads, BibTeX from arXiv metadata, and topic watches. Papers stay on disk. Search is optional.

relevance: Efficient paper reading for research agents.
